name: ai-security
description: Antral — agentic security team. Root launcher for all services.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,project,agent,web -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue "npm --prefix backend/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/auth run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/project run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/agent run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,project,agent -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix backend/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/auth run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/project run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/agent run dev"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,project,agent,web,desktop -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,white "node desktop/start-local-gateway.cjs" "npm --prefix backend/services/auth run dev" "npm --prefix backend/services/project run dev" "node desktop/start-local-agent.cjs" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "electron desktop/main.cjs"
